Cerchiamo qualcuno che lavori subito o su appuntamento nella nostra casa natale a Burgdorf. L'Ospedale Emmental, con i suoi specialisti nelle due sedi ospedaliere di Burgdorf e Langnau, fornisce assistenza medica di alta qualità a 150.000 residenti - 24 ore su 24. With specialists at the two hospital locations in Burgdorf and Langnau, the Emmental Hospital ensures high-quality medical care for 150,000 residents – around the clock. We are looking for someone to work in our birth center in Burgdorf immediately or by appointment. The Emmental Hospital, with its specialists at the two hospital locations in Burgdorf and Langnau, provides high-quality medical care for 150,000 residents - around the clock. To work in our birth center at the Burgdorf location, we are looking for someone immediately or by appointment. Your sphere of activity and how you can help shape it:
• With empathy, you accompany the expectant parents professionally, personally and individually during pregnancy, birth and the postpartum period
• You take responsibility for the implementation of the goals of the birth center and are committed to ongoing development
• There is the possibility of taking on specialist responsibility for the birth center
• You take part in meetings as well as the internal mandatory further training part
• You design your workload yourself This is what sets you apart
• You are qualified. Midwife HF/FH and have several years of professional experience
• You enjoy your job, are motivated and a team player
